name: Mercer County, PA
findings: Mercer County has 442 nonprofit organizations. 196 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 160 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Mercer County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
28% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 27 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 27 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Housing organizations stand out for membership
observations.text: 7 housing organizations here list membership, compared with about 1 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 7 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do housing organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?

observations.title: Fewer organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Mercer County list civic or political action on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 63% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 6 organizations here; 43% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to take civic or political action now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Few community organizations list membership
observations.text: 1 community organization here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.
